children.name: South West
children.tagline: West of England Music Hub (Bristol Beacon + WEMA)
description: South West listings start with the West of England Music Hub — the combined hub for Bristol and the surrounding authorities (formerly Bristol Music Hub plus partner LA services).
Hub Lead: Bristol Beacon. Delivery partner for Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire: West of England Music and Arts (WEMA).

about: From September 2024, Arts Council England appointed Bristol Beacon as Hub Lead Organisation for the West of England Music Hub, in partnership with WEMA.
This succeeds the former Bristol-only Music Hub and brings Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire into one regional hub under the National Plan for Music Education.

children.name: West of England Music Hub
children.tagline: Former Bristol Music Hub — now regional across four LAs
description: West of England Music Hub covers Bristol, Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire.
Bristol Beacon (Hub Lead) works with West of England Music and Arts (WEMA), who continue to deliver music education in the three authorities around Bristol.

about: Bristol Beacon has led music education for Bristol since 2011 (formerly Bristol Music Hub). From September 2024 it leads the wider West of England Music Hub under the National Plan for Music Education.
WEMA remains the delivery partner for Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire — the organisations work as one regional hub, not a single merged service brand.
schoolsEducation: School curriculum support, instrumental and vocal pathways, ensembles, workshops and inclusive music programmes across the four local authorities.
Bristol schools connect via Bristol Beacon Creative Learning; BANES, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire schools via WEMA Music Hub services.
training: Teacher CPD and networking through Bristol Beacon and WEMA — see each partner’s website for current courses.

resources.title: Inclusion strategy (Bristol Beacon)
resources.description: Hub commitment to equitable, diverse and inclusive opportunities for children and young people across the region.

resources.title: WEMA Music Hub at a glance
resources.description: Summary of WEMA school and family services by key stage.

children.name: Bristol Beacon
children.tagline: Hub Lead Organisation — former Bristol Music Hub
description: Bristol Beacon (Bristol Music Trust) is the Arts Council England Hub Lead Organisation for the West of England Music Hub.
It previously operated as the Music Education Hub for Bristol alone; the regional role now connects creative learning at the Beacon and Beacon Music Centre with partners across the West of England.

about: Bristol Beacon leads strategic coordination of the West of England Music Hub and continues city-wide music education and creative learning programmes in Bristol.
Official events, learning programmes and contacts are published on the Bristol Beacon website.
schoolsEducation: Creative Learning and Engagement programmes for schools and young people in Bristol, with regional hub leadership across the four LAs.

about: Bristol sits at the centre of the West of England Music Hub. Bristol Beacon remains the Hub Lead and the main city delivery partner.
This CCDesigner page is a directory entry for teachers — programmes and booking live on Bristol Beacon and WEMA sites.
schoolsEducation: Curriculum and co-curricular music, ensembles and inclusive pathways for Bristol schools and settings.

Offer includes instrumental and vocal tuition, ensembles, school workshops, curriculum support, Creative Health / inclusion, CPD and events.

about: West of England Music and Arts (WEMA) is the delivery partner for the three local authorities surrounding Bristol within the West of England Music Hub.
Full programme listings, booking and CPD live on the WEMA Music Hub website.
schoolsEducation: In-school curriculum music / PPA cover, whole-class ensemble teaching, instrumental and vocal lessons, workshops and resource packs.
Creative Health and inclusion programmes for vulnerable children and whole-school work.
training: Teacher CPD and networking for music leads — see WEMA for current opportunities.
